children: France conglomerate's H1 2026 revenue grew 8% at constant scope and exchange rates
Net income Group share fell sharply compared to H1 2025
Company announced exceptional interim dividend of €2.5 bln
Company did not provide specific guidance or outlook for the current or future periods
HIGHER ENERGY PRICES - Bolloré Energy revenue rose amid rising prices linked to conflict in the Middle East, despite lower volumes sold
SEGMENT MIX - Industry segment saw slight growth driven by higher volumes in dielectric films and packaging, while Blue activities declined
SCOPE CHANGES - 'Other' segment revenue fell due to exit of Ovrsea from consolidation and lower real estate revenue
Sept 15 - TotalEnergies launches three-year AI development programme with Mistral
Sept 16 - Carney visits Europe to seek closer ties amid worsening trade war with Trump
Sept 15 - French central bank trims growth outlook as demand softens
